intent: A complete supported narrow Keep page without flat contain gaps, while retaining original owner/source/draft continuity.

runtimeBaseline.additionalFileProblem: Root observed one64px pending attachment shelf making auto-bottom push the note from343.6 toabout278 under the source window. This is a layout-coupling problem, not a reason to hide attachment/reference/draft controls.

candidates.selection: full-room direction for root comparison only
candidates.strength: Full person, whole shoes, own book and shared room remain visible. Natural curtain/window/floor/rug across all edges is materially better than flat letterbox bars.
candidates.limit: The generative concept still repaints/reframes the source instead of proving a pixel-identical contain camera. Exact actor/receiver/camera invariance is NOT approved. Cat and some typography differ from actual scales. Current body/masks must not be replaced with this PNG.
candidates.implementationBurden: A future clean extension would need root-admitted empty environment and the original actor/receiver/F/S layers kept in one unchanged source transform. No new pose or existing-body reconstruction. Extension continuity must be checked in actual supported sizes and themes.

candidates.selection: root-approved narrow representation/object relationship only; native implementation still pending production verification
candidates.strength: An actual dedicated avatar and one cat retain role identity while the person yields all reading space. Continuous lamp/wood/rain material has no contain bars. One pending PDF cover remains inside the same writer, distinct from saved entrances. The note has a stable starting position and extra files grow the page downward.
candidates.limit: It is a newly composed desk concept, not an approved clean runtime background. Cat is about150CSSpx rather than70–90 and must use the existing rig dimensions. Printed PDF texture is invented; actual PDF bytes/pages and all controls remain native. The pending file name was not supplied, so no fictional name/thumbnail was invented.
candidates.implementationBurden: Use the existing scene/portrait representation boundary and approved avatar/cat, with no body under the work. The smallest alternative to a new desk asset is a safe cover-crop of the existing clean empty plate in narrow Keep, because there is no actor/support to crop. A dedicated new clean desk background, if chosen, needs a separate root static gate; never crop this UI mock.

layoutRecommendation.stableStart: While writing, use one ordinary flow column from a stable top chosen from the existing source-window geometry/default safe boundary. Remove composer-height-dependent auto-bottom anchoring for that state. The native reader frame remains its original owner; do not create another geometry or content store.
layoutRecommendation.growth: Keep source chip and actual draft state in their compact first row, then all1–3 original attachments/thumbnails, then the same form. Added rows increase page length below the note. Saved icon entrances continue below and remain reachable by ordinary vertical scrolling. No controls/files/text hidden, no new input.
layoutRecommendation.unknown: Exact final contentTop and how saved user-resized reader geometry participates remain parent implementation choices; concept coordinates are intentions, not current DOM measurements. No CSS or business change authorized by this comparison.
